Name: War Hammer
Description: Its strikes send tremors through the earth and through your enemies' hearts.

Name: Pike
Description: Enemies won't want to get the wrong end of the stick when they run into you.

Name: Sword
Description: A classic sword used by heroes and survivors since the dawn of the Overworld.

Name: Double Daggers
Description: When one dagger just isn't fast enough.

Name: Short Spear
Description: With the right wielder, even a short spear can reach across dimensions.

Name: Rapier
Description: A nimble and narrow blade that strikes with fierce ferocity.

Name: The Burning Blade
Description: A flame frozen into steel that erupts when you swing it.

Name: Spectral Spear
Description: A spear forged in ichor and possessed by souls that will burn all enemies you point at.

Name: The Thousand Cuts
Description: A nimble sword for the fencing virtuoso that strikes faster than other blades.

Name: Claymore
Description: A massive sword that rests easily in a righteous warrior's hands.

Name: Greatsword
Description: If your heart is just, even the greatest sword will feel light as a feather.

Name: Wolf Claws
Description: A respectful offering from your wolf friends, for close combat beneath the full moon.

Name: Glaive
Description: A wise blacksmith once stuck a sword on top of a staff and the world has never been the same.

Name: Battlestaff
Description: With extra weights on the ends for striking fear into your enemies.

Name: Meat Cleaver
Description: A reliable kitchen cleaver repurposed for serving up justice.

Name: Double Sickles
Description: Harvest tools from Honeycomb Fields, repurposed for reaping illagers and monsters.

Name: Scythe
Description: Fit only for toiling warriors, the scythe truly separates the wheat from the chaff.

Name: Clobberer
Description: For those who prefer a less subtle approach to problem solving.

Name: Shovel
Description: When planning for revenge, you must dig two graves: one for your enemy. And one... for your other enemy.

Name: Mace
Description: A brutal tool of war, but what it lacks in finesse it makes up for in power.

Name: Twilight Dagger
Description: A must-have in any rogue's inventory.

Name: Sabre
Description: A slightly curved sword for when you want to paint with broad strokes.

Name: Battle Hammer
Description: Strike while the iron is still hot.

Name: Tidal Sickle
Description: A harvest tool for the new dimension, perfect for reaping souls.

Name: Greataxe
Description: A good axe settles for having a blade on one side. This is no goodaxe.

Name: The Darkshard
Description: A legendary sword forged in the Deep Dark with amethyst alloy in the blade.

Name: Golden Glaive
Description: A glaive of pure gold for the brave warrior who leads the charge.

Name: Elemental Staff
Description: A powerful staff that unleashes the elements of fire, ice, poison and electricity on your enemies.

Name: Cacaphonous Cleaver
Description: A mystical meat cleaver that serves souls for dessert.

Name: Monster Masher
Description: A mallet made from humbler husk that guards as hard as it hits.

Name: Frostbiter
Description: A frost-infused longsword fit only for the coolest of warriors.

Name: Diamond Shovel
Description: A durable diamond shovel enchanted with the power to blast enemies away.

Name: Carapace Mace
Description: Hard as nails but light as a feather, this mace is perfect for rolling and jumping attacks.

Name: Lunar Sickle
Description: Leave your enemies reeling and ripe for the reaping.

Name: Crossbow
Description: The ranged weapon of choice for the Pillager warriors.

Name: Shortbow
Description: A shorter, weaker bow with a faster fire rate and quicker charge time.

Name: Trickbow
Description: For the trick shooter who likes to roll, jump, and shoot ricocheting arrows.

Name: Powerbow
Description: For the patient ranger who doesn't like to waste arrows.

Name: Dual Crossbows
Description: When one crossbow just isn't enough.

Name: Shooting Star
Description: When you wish upon this star, you will evade enemy projectiles and shoot back.

Name: The Close Ranger
Description: Judge your enemies up close and personal.

Name: The Cross Pollinator
Description: Cross-pollinate mobs with sharpened twigs and see what grows from their remains.

Name: Greatbow
Description: A powerful bow that fires with such force your arrows pierce even the toughest of enemies.

Name: Double Crossers
Description: These enchanted crossbows power up when you roll, firing with extra force.

Name: Humbler Heartstring
Description: This greatbow beats like the heart of a Humbler and pierces through the toughest husks.

Name: Scamp Sneakers
Description: For sneaking up on enemies and taking their loot.

Name: Scamp Hood
Description: For blending into dark corners and sneaking through the night.

Name: Scamp Jacket
Description: Holds extra space for keeping tricks up your sleeves.

Name: Scamp Leggings
Description: For when you need to leg it fast.

Name: Nomad Boots
Description: A pair of reliable boots for traversing the Overworld in search of adventure.

Name: Nomad Chestplate
Description: A sturdy chestplate for roaming the Overworld in search of justice.

Name: Nomad Hood
Description: A rainproof hood for wandering the Overworld in search of danger.

Name: Dauntless Horns
Description: Ram into your enemies with this horned helmet to knock them down a peg.

Name: Dauntless Sabatons
Description: For the dauntless warrior who has a lot of heart but needs a lot of souls.

Name: Rover Sabatons
Description: A pair of durable iron boots that keep you on your toes when in danger.

Name: Rover Pauldrons
Description: A protective chestplate with thick pauldrons to deflect ranged attacks.

Name: Rover Visor
Description: A reliable helmet with an enhanced visor for critical precision.

Name: Rover Gaiters
Description: A pair of limber iron gaiters for extra attack momentum.

Name: Sharpshooter Duster
Description: A delicious-looking duster with stabilizing arm guards for powerful ranged attacks.

Name: Sharpshooter Chaps
Description: A pair of sharp leather chaps for fletching arrows in the wild.

Name: Sharpshooter Spurs
Description: A pair of spurred shoes with ankle space for extra arrows.

Name: Sharpshooter Fedora
Description: A flashy fedora with an attached monocle scope for aiming multiple arrows at once.

Name: Protector Chestplate
Description: Passed down for generations to serve a chosen protector. A heavy burden!

Name: Protector Boots
Description: Passed down for generations to serve a chosen protector. Big shoes to fill!

Name: Packleader Paws
Description: A pair of wolf fur boots with razor-sharp claws, perfect for fletching extra arrows.

Name: Packleader Hide
Description: Lead with your heart and show your pack who they are fighting for.

Name: Packleader Muzzle
Description: See through the eyes of a wolf and spot enemies at far distances.

Name: Mystic Circlet
Description: A Magician's circlet with an obsidian stone scavenged from a broken portal.

Name: Mystic Robe
Description: An Evoker's robe retailored to suit a far more handsome wearer.

Name: Mystic Boots
Description: An Evoker's boots repurposed for kicking Illager butt with an iron toe to boot.

Name: Beekeeper Veil
Description: Keeps enemies out of your face without compromising your vision.

Name: Beekeeper Suit
Description: Shields you from the swarms as you reach for their golden treasures.

Name: Beekeeper Leggings
Description: As far as leggings go, these truly are the bee's knees.

Name: Beekeeper Boots
Description: Adds a buzz to your step and a sting to your kicks.

Name: Disciple Robe
Description: A true warrior must cover their heart, or its beating will wake the Wardens.

Name: Disciple Wraps
Description: A true warrior wears soundproof foot wraps to spare the ground from trembling.

Name: Redstone Chestplate
Description: Your victory is already set in redstone.

Name: Redstone Boots
Description: Cobbled from the rubble of a Redstone Monstrosity.

Name: Dreamruler Crown
Description: A crown as soft as a pillow for tranquil dreams of soul gathering.

Name: Dreamruler Cover
Description: A chestplate as comfy as a bedcover, helping you focus on your targets.

Name: Dreamruler Pyjamas
Description: A pair of pyjama pants as light as shadows, helping you sneak through your enemy's nightmares.

Name: Dreamruler Slippers
Description: A pair of slippers so cozy you'll roll out of bed and jump into battle!

Name: Woodsprite Crown
Description: A dark oak mask crowned with enchanted flowers that grant natural resistance to your pets.

Name: Woodsprite Trunks
Description: A pair of thorned treetrunk leggings for prickly kicking back when under attack.

Name: Fly Agaric Cap
Description: An enchanted mushroom cap for poisoned punches and toxic terror.

Name: Fly Agaric Trousers
Description: Don't eat the trousers! They are poisonous to humans but grant extra strength to your pets.

Name: Fly Agaric Galoshes
Description: Give your pet companions a nibble of these galoshes and it will grant them natural resistance.

Name: Sage Belt
Description: A warrior worthy of this belt will roll a hundred times without getting dizzy.

Name: Sage Wraps
Description: A warrior worthy of these foot wraps will strike as swiftly as an axolotl.

Name: Mad Sifter Mask
Description: A tainted mask fashioned like an enraged Sifter, designed to scare your enemies to their core.

Name: Mad Sifter Vest
Description: An enchanted vest fashioned like an enraged Sifter that grants enraged power to all artifacts.

Name: Mad Sifter Slacks
Description: A pair of slacks fashioned like Sifter legs, imbued with boosting powers.

Name: Mad Sifter Paws
Description: A pair of boots fashioned like Sifter paws, just as quick to deflect ranged attacks.

Name: Alchemist Overcoat
Description: An alchemist's old overcoat that grants extra power to all artifacts.

Name: Alchemist Trousers
Description: An alchemist's old trousers that generate health from all artifacts.

Name: Alchemist Loafers
Description: An alchemist's old loafers with stacked soles AND stacked with souls!

Name: Monarch Crown
Description: A worthy crown of ichor crust that will have your enemies throw gifts at your feet.

Name: Monarch Mantle
Description: A majestic mantle worthy of a Monarch, with extra resilience against the elements.

Name: Monarch Sash
Description: A noble sash made from Monarch plume, with extra space for hoarding souls.

Name: Monarch Talons
Description: A pair of regal boots with sharp talons. Be the top of the ecosystem in every dimension.

Name: Picnic Basket
Description: Great day for a picnic! Share healthy treats with your friends. Hangry friends make for bad allies in battle.

Name: Corrupted Beacon
Description: Turns souls into raw power as you fire it in short bursts or in one long, soul-draining blast of ultimate power.

Name: Death Cap Mushroom
Description: Eaten by daring warriors before battle to enter a berserker state, increasing both movement and attack speed.

Name: Totem of Shielding
Description: This solid gold totem radiates a protective barrier, shielding all inside it from projectiles.

Name: Totem of Casting
Description: Place the totem on the ground to spread artificing energy to your allies, reducing their artifact cooldown time.

Name: Ender Fog
Description: The Ender Fog smoke bomb lets you sneak up on enemies, cloaked by shadows.

Name: Pouch of Frost
Description: Throw it on the ground to spread a blistering blizzard around yourself. One of the coolest artifacts there is!

Name: Pouch of Poison
Description: Throw it on the ground to spread toxic terror around yourself. Don't worry, this mob repellent is completely eco-friendly.

Name: Pouch of Thunder
Description: Throw it on the ground to spread conductive chaos around yourself. It's a real power trip!

Name: Lightning Rod
Description: Channels soul-powered lightning, zapping your enemies silly for as long as you hold it.

Name: Fighting Fungus
Description: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, unleashing their rage and increasing their attack speed.

Name: Tempo Truffle
Description: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, sending them charging into battle with increased movement speed.

Name: Grindstone
Description: Sharpen your weapons on the grindstone to make enemies feel the sting of your steel and cause extra damage.

Name: Warding Chimes
Description: Chimes crafted from humbler husk. Their music turns your skin as thick as carapace.

Name: Battle Banner
Description: Raise the banner of war and grant strength to you and all nearby allies.

Name: Winter Staff
Description: Blasts a soul-powered blizzard at your enemies and creates a cozy winter wonderland.

Name: Blizzard Bangle
Description: Imbues your attacks with the power of freezing blizzards and looks really cool on your wrist!

Name: Blight Bangle
Description: Imbues your attacks with poisonous power and looks stunning on your wrist!

Name: Electric Bangle
Description: Imbues your attacks with the power of crackling electricity and looks striking on your wrist!

Name: Powershaker
Description: Let's shake things up! The Powershaker is a smashing good time and will blow your enemies' minds!

Name: Firework Arrow
Description: TNT 的爆炸威力加上箭矢的射速，还能出什么岔子呢？

Name: Venomous Quiver
Description: A quiver soaked in venom for that extra sting when your arrows bite.

Name: Freezing Quiver
Description: These arrows will have your enemies quivering from both fear and cold.

Name: Conductive Quiver
Description: These arrows will strike your enemies like lightning from the skies.

Name: Wonderful Wheat
Description: Summons a woolly wanderer to watch over you in battle!

Name: Tasty Bone
Description: Summons a furry friend to fight by your side!
